title: A baseline-risk bridge across a disconnected network
question: When disconnected subnetworks are linked through exchangeable baseline risks, does study-level design nuisance pass into the cross-gap contrast, and can design covariates separate it from prognosis?
design: Two subnetworks with prognostic drift, a design nuisance on the baseline and a design covariate overlapping the gap or not; exchangeable-baseline bridge with and without design adjustment. 24 cells, 2000 replicates each.
